title: Checklist-based Beneficiary Selection per Village in Distribution Recording

requirements.text: In the 'Catat Distribusi' (Record Distribution) page, replace the free-text beneficiary name input with a searchable checklist selector that pulls data from the existing Sasaran (beneficiary) records. The checklist must group beneficiaries by village (desa), allowing the inputter to expand each village group and check/uncheck individual beneficiaries. Multiple beneficiaries can be selected at once before submitting the distribution record.

quotes: pada menu catat distribusi nama penerima mamfaat pengimput dapat mengetik sasaran yang diambil dari data sasaran dengan sistem ceklis , pada masing masing desa

acceptanceCriteria: The distribution form displays a searchable input that filters the beneficiary checklist by name or village as the user types.
Beneficiaries are grouped under their respective village (desa) headers in the checklist.
Each village group can be expanded or collapsed to show/hide its beneficiaries.
The user can check one or more beneficiaries across multiple villages before submitting.
The selected beneficiaries are visually highlighted/summarized before form submission.
Only active/eligible Sasaran records are shown in the checklist.
The checklist data is fetched from the existing backend Sasaran store, not manually entered.

requirements.text: Update the backend distribution recording logic to accept a list of selected beneficiary IDs (one per distribution entry or as a batch), so that when multiple beneficiaries are checked in the form, each receives their own distribution record linked to the selected package and date.

quotes: nama penerima mamfaat pengimput dapat mengetik sasaran yang diambil dari data sasaran dengan sistem ceklis

acceptanceCriteria: The backend accepts a batch of sasaran IDs for a single distribution submission.
Each selected sasaran ID generates an individual distribution record with the same package, date, and status.
Existing single-beneficiary distribution creation remains backward compatible.
The distribution list/table correctly displays all batch-created entries.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Beneficiary data must be sourced exclusively from existing Sasaran records in the backend — no manual free-text entry for beneficiary names.
Village grouping must use the existing desa field already present in Sasaran records.
nonGoals: Adding or editing village (desa) records from within the distribution form.
Changing the overall layout or navigation of the Dashboard.
Modifying the Sasaran management page itself.
Real-time collaborative editing of distribution records.
